name: Kyushu & Shikoku, 9 nights
goal: Example mission: 福岡 to 高松 by ferry, bike, mountain bus and trail, 26 Sep to 5 Oct 2026. Times are Japan time.
highlight: Lost in the fog on 剣山, then finding the way to 次郎笈. Scared at first, then exciting.

blocks.title: Immigration and customs, FUK
blocks.note: Land 19:40. Passport control, then the subway is right there.

blocks.title: Subway to 博多
blocks.note: Five minutes. ¥260.

blocks.title: Check in, 9h nine hours Hakata
blocks.note: Capsule, ¥7,760. Drop the pack before the stalls.

blocks.title: Over to 中洲
blocks.note: Or 天神 — where people who live there actually eat.

blocks.title: 中洲の屋台
blocks.note: おでん, grilled 明太子, 餃子, 豚骨ラーメン to finish; 焼酎 with hot water. 20–30 minutes queueing at most stalls.

blocks.title: 9h nine hours Hakata Station
blocks.note: Capsule, ¥7,760.

blocks.title: Check out, walk to 博多駅
Breakfast
blocks.note: Konbini or station — and something for the train.

blocks.title: 特急ソニック 博多 → 別府
blocks.note: Booked. 2h14.

blocks.title: 竹瓦温泉 砂湯
blocks.note: 1879 bathhouse. Book the sand-bath slot the moment you arrive. Ten to fifteen minutes buried is the ceiling.

blocks.title: Drop the pack at 萬力屋
blocks.note: Five-room onsen ryokan in 鉄輪.

blocks.title: Queue, 地獄蒸し工房
blocks.note: Longer than planned: 30+ minutes in the rain.

blocks.title: 地獄蒸し工房 鉄輪
blocks.note: Twenty minutes cooking over a geothermal vent, then eat. Get the corn.

blocks.title: 鉄輪むし湯
blocks.note: Stone steam chamber on a floor of medicinal herbs. ¥700, yukata ¥220, last entry 19:00. Covers the 15:00 shower. Replaces the ropeway: the summit is in cloud.

blocks.title: Walk to 鉄輪 bus stop
blocks.note: A couple of minutes down いでゆ坂; you'll pass some of the steam anyway.

blocks.title: Bus down to 別府駅 / ゆめタウン
blocks.note: Any bus toward 別府駅. For ゆめタウン, it's about 15 minutes' walk south-east of the station, or a short taxi in the rain.

blocks.title: ABC-MART ゆめタウン別府, 2F
blocks.note: Replaces the 鉄輪 alleys. Big store with lots of sneakers, open until 21:00, indoors out of the rain. Bring your passport and ask about tax-free. Smaller alternative: ABC-MART in トキハ別府 専門店棟 3F, near 北浜, open until 19:00.

blocks.title: Walk to 駅前通り
blocks.note: About 15 minutes from ゆめタウン.

blocks.title: 駅前通り
blocks.note: Small, scruffy, entirely local. Ask 萬力屋 about festivals and check tomorrow's ferry when you get back.

blocks.title: To 別府国際観光港
blocks.note: Bus or taxi from 鉄輪.

blocks.title: Fill in the boarding card
blocks.note: No reservation needed on foot. ¥4,900 second class.

blocks.title: Ferry 別府 → 八幡浜
blocks.note: 宇和島運輸, 2h45. Second class is a tatami floor: shoes off, lie down.

blocks.title: Walk to 八幡浜駅
blocks.note: Twenty minutes.

blocks.title: JR予讃線 → 松山
blocks.note: About an hour. Confirm the time; JR Shikoku hasn't published autumn.

blocks.title: Tram straight to 道後温泉
blocks.note: No castle stop now. 伊予鉄 from JR松山駅前.

blocks.title: Check in, Hotel Patio Dogo
blocks.note: ¥8,000. Two minutes from the Honkan. If it's too early for the room, leave the pack.

blocks.title: Late lunch in 道後
blocks.note: Nothing planned since breakfast.

blocks.title: Walk to 石手寺
blocks.note: About fifteen minutes east of the Honkan.

blocks.title: 石手寺
blocks.note: Temple 51 of the 88. Your plan's alternative to the castle; 松山城 comes back in 高知城 on Sunday.

blocks.title: ニュー道後ミュージック, 1回目
blocks.note: Deadline: Show starts. First of four shows (17:00, 18:50, 20:40, 22:30). No outside food or drink; drinks are sold inside. Times can change on the day, so ask staff or check @DOUGOMUSIC. The 22:30 show is still there if you'd rather do this after the bath.

blocks.title: Quick dinner in the arcade
blocks.note: Only half an hour, so something fast. You had a late lunch.

blocks.title: Check the crowd level
blocks.note: dogo.or.jp/crowd-level. If they're issuing 整理券, take one and wait in the arcade.

blocks.title: 道後温泉本館, 神の湯 二階席
blocks.note: ¥1,300, one hour. Buy at the outside 札場, show the ticket at reception and again upstairs. Yukata provided, towel not: bring one or buy one. Soap and shampoo are in the bath. Tea and a sweet at your seat afterwards.

blocks.title: Evening walk, 道後 arcade
blocks.note: The Honkan lit up, 振鷺閣 glowing red.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel, lay out tomorrow
blocks.note: Deadline: Last 二階席 ticket. Tram at 07:12 and 70km on the bike.

blocks.title: Hotel Patio Dogo
blocks.note: A full night before the しまなみ day.

blocks.title: Rain delay, 松山
blocks.note: Waited out the morning rain instead of the 08:10 しおかぜ.

blocks.title: Buy lunch at JR松山駅
blocks.note: Onigiri or a bento. There's no proper lunch stop on the shortened ride.

blocks.title: 特急しおかぜ → 今治
blocks.note: Arrives 12:01. Eat on the train.

blocks.title: Pick up the assist bike
blocks.note: Right outside the station, open until 19:00. Rain gear on, pack in the front basket. Ask if any bridge is closed for wind.

blocks.title: Ride to 来島海峡大橋
blocks.note: About 8km from the station.

blocks.title: 来島海峡展望館
blocks.note: Quick stop: 今治タオル and a look at the bridge. Skip it if the rain is heavy.

blocks.title: Ride: 大島 → 伯方島
blocks.note: Checkpoint: be past 伯方島 by 14:30.

blocks.title: マリンオアシスはかた
blocks.note: 伯方の塩ソフトクリーム, 15 minutes at most.

blocks.title: Ride: 大三島 east coast → 多々羅
blocks.note: Deadline: Past 伯方島. The blue line only. 大山祇神社 is dropped: the 10km detour doesn't fit.

blocks.title: サイクリストの聖地碑
blocks.note: The photo of the ride, at the foot of 多々羅大橋.

blocks.title: Ride over 多々羅大橋 → 瀬戸田サンセットビーチ
blocks.note: Past レモン谷. You reached Sunset Beach at 16:09.

blocks.title: Ride into 瀬戸田 town
blocks.note: Too late to ride on to 尾道 before dark, so the boat it was.

blocks.title: 瀬戸田 lemon gelato
blocks.note: If there was time.

blocks.title: Ferry 瀬戸田 → 尾道, with the bike
blocks.note: Deadline: Last boat 瀬戸田 → 尾道. ¥1,500 + ¥500 for the bike; cash, card or IC. You're on the water at sunset instead of on a bridge. If they won't take the bike, drop it at 瀬戸田 before 17:00 (both terminals there close at 17:00) and board without it.

blocks.title: Walk the bike to 尾道駅前
blocks.note: A few minutes from the pier.

blocks.title: Return the bike, 尾道駅前
blocks.note: Open until 19:00.

blocks.title: Check in, 尾道第一ホテル
blocks.note: Booked. Three minutes from the south exit. Hang up the wet gear.

blocks.title: Start the coin laundry
blocks.note: Put the wet gear in before you go; collect it when you're back.

blocks.title: Walk to 尾道みなと館
blocks.note: About 1.2km, 15 minutes; taxi if it's still raining.

blocks.title: Sauna, 天然温泉 尾道みなと館
blocks.note: Day bathing 12:00–22:00: ¥651 on weekdays, sauna +¥350. Radium hot spring. Bring the hotel towel. I couldn't confirm a cold bath or the tattoo rule; ask at the desk.

blocks.title: Walk back to 尾道駅
blocks.note: Or a taxi if it is raining.

blocks.title: Ramen
blocks.note: 尾道ラーメン near the station.

blocks.title: 尾道 bike return closes
blocks.note: Hard deadline.

blocks.title: Hotel breakfast
blocks.note: Check the start time at check-in; konbini a minute away.

blocks.title: 普通 瀬戸行き → 岡山
blocks.note: Straight through, no change. Not the 09:03.

blocks.title: Change at 岡山
blocks.note: JR West to JR Shikoku: follow 瀬戸大橋線 / 四国方面.

blocks.title: 特急南風5号 → 大歩危
blocks.note: Booked. Window seat for the 吉野川.

blocks.title: Walk to 道の駅大歩危
blocks.note: Twenty minutes, or a short taxi.

blocks.title: 大歩危峡 遊覧船
blocks.note: Thirty minutes between walls of schist. ~¥1,500, card OK.

blocks.title: Lunch at the 道の駅
blocks.note: 祖谷そば or でこまわし.

blocks.title: 妖怪屋敷と石の博物館
blocks.note: One ¥800 ticket. Seven minutes from the dock.

blocks.title: Bus → 秘境の湯
blocks.note: 四国交通 祖谷線, ~¥720.

blocks.title: Check in, ホテル秘境の湯
blocks.note: Booked. No wifi in the annex.

blocks.title: Onsen: 大浴場 and 露天
blocks.note: Glass wall onto the gorge forest. Tattoos prohibited.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.note: 祖谷そば, あめご, 阿波牛石焼き, 四国 sake.

blocks.title: Check Thursday's forecast
blocks.note: The hut cancels free until tonight. Decide here.

blocks.title: Decide on the summit
blocks.note: Hard deadline.

blocks.title: Morning bath
blocks.note: The only morning hours. Don't sleep through them.

blocks.title: Pack, check out
blocks.note: Nothing to buy further up the valley.

blocks.title: Walk to the bus stop
blocks.note: The public 四国交通 bus, not the hotel shuttle: the shuttle only runs down to 大歩危駅, the wrong way.

blocks.title: Bus → かずら橋夢舞台
blocks.note: 四国交通 祖谷線, the 10:07 from 大歩危駅前, heading up the valley. Its sign shows ホテル祖谷温泉 行き. ✅ Board if it shows ホテル祖谷温泉 or かずら橋夢舞台. ❌ Not 大歩危 or 三好病院: wrong way. Not sure? Ask: 「かずら橋夢舞台まで行きますか？」 Take a 整理券, pay cash when you get off. No bus by 10:30: 四国交通, 0883-72-1231.

blocks.title: 祖谷のかずら橋
blocks.note: ¥550 cash. Expect a queue. Then the riverbed path and 琵琶の滝.

blocks.title: Lunch: 祖谷そば
blocks.note: Sit down for a proper bowl. Nothing else until 17:30.

blocks.title: 東祖谷線 → 久保
blocks.note: Deadline: Last bus up. The last bus up. Sign: 久保 行き (via 京上). ✅ Board if it shows 久保. ❌ Not 大歩危 or 三好病院: that goes back down the valley. Take a 整理券, pay cash when you get off. Miss it: Kazurabashi Taxi, 0883-87-2013.

blocks.title: Change at 久保
blocks.note: Two minutes. No later service. Have the fare ready in coins so you're off first, and tell the driver 「剣山線に乗り換えます」 (I'm changing to the 剣山 bus).

blocks.title: 剣山線 → 見ノ越
blocks.note: Deadline: 2-min change. 三好市営バス, a small city bus, not 四国交通. Sign: 二重かずら橋・剣山 行き. The 名頃 → 剣山 part is a limited-season run, so confirm it's running today: 三好市営バス 0883-72-7607 or 0883-88-2211. ✅ Board if it shows 剣山 or 二重かずら橋. Ask: 「剣山まで行きますか？」

blocks.title: Walk to the lift
blocks.note: Arrived at the lift station at 14:17 and chose the lift over the full hike.

blocks.title: Lift to 西島
blocks.note: 見ノ越 1,420m → 西島 1,750m, 15 minutes. ¥1,300 one way, cash only.

blocks.title: Walk to the summit
blocks.note: 西島 1,750m → summit 1,955m: about 205m up with the pack.

blocks.title: Checked in, 剣山頂上ヒュッテ
blocks.note: Made it. Futon rental ¥1,500.

blocks.title: Hut dinner, everyone together
blocks.note: Ask who's getting down by car tomorrow.

blocks.title: Stars
blocks.note: Lights out at 21:00, but you can go out all night.

blocks.title: 剣山頂上ヒュッテ 本館
blocks.note: No wifi, no hot shower.

blocks.title: At the hut
blocks.note: Hard deadline.

blocks.title: Sunrise
blocks.note: ~05:55, from the terrace or an east window.

blocks.title: Into the fog
blocks.note: Visibility down to a few metres on the summit plateau.

blocks.title: Lost at a junction
blocks.note: The signs pointed to the lift, 見の越 via 大剣神社, and 一の森, but not 次郎笈. You worked your way back and found the right path.

blocks.title: 剣山 → 次郎笈 ridge in the fog
blocks.note: On the right path at 08:03. Scared at first, then exciting: the highlight of the trip.

blocks.title: Back and down to 見ノ越
blocks.note: At the bus stop by 11:14.

blocks.title: 三好市営バス → 久保
blocks.note: Deadline: Only useful bus. Sign: 久保 行き. The 剣山 departure is a limited-season run; the hut will know if it's running. ✅ Board if it shows 久保. It's the only useful bus down until 14:55. Ask: 「久保まで行きますか？」

blocks.title: Buy snacks at 久保
blocks.note: No lunch stop today.

blocks.title: 東祖谷線 → かずら橋夢舞台
blocks.note: This bus ends at かずら橋夢舞台; it doesn't go on to 阿波池田. Sign: かずら橋夢舞台 行き. ✅ Board if it shows かずら橋夢舞台. ❌ Not 剣山 or 二重かずら橋: that goes back up. Pay cash when you get off.

blocks.title: Change at かずら橋夢舞台
blocks.note: Get off, take a new 整理券 on the next bus. Eleven minutes; stay at the stop.

blocks.title: 西祖谷線 → 大歩危駅前
blocks.note: Deadline: Change bus at かずら橋夢舞台. Sign: 三好病院 行き (via 大歩危駅前 and 阿波池田). ✅ Board if it shows 三好病院 or 大歩危駅前. ❌ Not 久保. Get off at 大歩危駅前, not 阿波池田: the train to 高知 leaves 大歩危 earlier.

blocks.title: Change at 大歩危駅
blocks.note: Ten minutes. Platform ①. Ride 自由席 and pay the conductor, or buy at the counter if there's no queue.

blocks.title: 特急南風 → 高知
blocks.note: Deadline: 南風 from 大歩危. From 大歩危 at 13:44, platform ①. About an hour to 高知. ✅ Board if it shows 特急 and 高知 (or 中村 / 宿毛). ❌ Not 岡山 or 高松. Missed it: the next 特急 from 大歩危 is 14:42, also platform ①.

blocks.title: Check in, 高知
blocks.note: Still to book: BONITO, a hotel, or EN+.

blocks.title: ひろめ市場
blocks.note: Straw-seared katsuo, salt not ponzu. Seats are hard to find.

blocks.title: Start down
blocks.note: Hard deadline.

blocks.title: Slow breakfast
blocks.note: No trains today.

blocks.title: To とさのさと
blocks.note: About twenty minutes out.

blocks.title: 土佐の豊穣祭
blocks.note: 和太鼓, 神楽, 太刀踊り and よさこい. Free.

blocks.title: Festival food
blocks.note: Ayu over salt, 田舎寿司, 土佐あかうし.

blocks.title: Pick up a free numbered ticket
blocks.note: Needed for the stage area.

blocks.title: LIVE UNDER KOCHI CASTLE
blocks.note: Free, this Saturday only. 濱長 花神楽 geiko.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.note: ひろめ市場 or 帯屋町.

blocks.title: EN+ Sauna, 帯屋町
blocks.note: ¥2,000. 「宴」 and 「園」, ginger loyly.

blocks.title: 高知の日曜市
blocks.note: The planned last morning in 高知.

blocks.title: 特急 → 高松
blocks.note: No 金刀比羅宮 and no temple stop: straight on to 高松.

blocks.title: KOKO Hotel sold out: find a bed
blocks.note: A last-minute hunt around 高松駅 and 瓦町.

blocks.title: Shopping, 高松 商店街
blocks.note: Rain washed out 栗林公園, so the arcades instead: things you can only buy in Japan.

blocks.title: Queue at 3番のりば, 高松駅
UO643 高松 → 香港
blocks.note: Deadline: UO643. Lands 18:25 Hong Kong time. Home.

memos.2026-09-26: Landed in 福岡 and went straight to the 中洲 stalls for the first night.
memos.2026-09-27: Rain in 別府: a long wet queue at 地獄蒸し, the herb steam bath むし湯 instead of a ropeway lost in cloud, and sneakers at ゆめタウン.
memos.2026-09-28: Across the 豊予海峡 by ferry, then 道後: 石手寺, ニュー道後ミュージック and the Honkan in the evening.
memos.2026-09-29: Rain kept you in 松山 until 11:20, but you still rode: 今治 over the 来島海峡大橋 to 瀬戸田, reaching Sunset Beach at 16:09, then the 17:00 boat into 尾道 at sunset.
memos.2026-09-30: Two trains to 大歩危, the gorge, and a quiet night at 秘境の湯.
memos.2026-10-01: The day of no second chances, and every connection made: you confirmed the seasonal 剣山 bus by phone in Japanese, made the two-minute change at 久保, rode the lift and checked into the summit hut at 1,955m.
memos.2026-10-02: The highlight of the trip. Thick fog on the summit, lost at an unmarked junction at 07:14, back on the right path to 次郎笈 by 08:03. Scared at first, then exciting. Down to 見ノ越 in time for the 11:12.
memos.2026-10-03: 高知: the harvest festival, 高知城, and the HOKAs.
memos.2026-10-04: Change of plan: no 金刀比羅宮, no temple night. You went to 高松 instead, found KOKO Hotel sold out at 20:00, and hunted down a bed.
memos.2026-10-05: Rain washed out 栗林公園, so the last morning became shopping: bags of things you can only buy in Japan. Then the 13:20 bus and UO643 home.
